rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` has the front matter that marks a bundled skill, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material. Each such link must say when to read the file. I checked every link to a separate file:

- **`references/fixme.md`:** the "Fixing findings" table row says to read it for "a real gap the user agrees to defer, a FIXME judgment, or a `{fixme}` issue that closed".
- **`references/reviews.md`:** the same table says to read it for a "false citation or site review".
- **`references/authoring-failures.md`:** the last Gotchas bullet says to read it "if authoring fails on configuration, credentials, throttling, or a denied mandatory input".
- **The CI example, `../habeas/references/ci.md`:** the "Testing and coverage findings" section introduces it with "For CI integration, recommend the separate collection and check steps in the Habeas CI example". That sentence names the situation, CI integration, so it states when to read the file. It is less explicit than the "read" phrasing of the other links, but it meets the requirement.

No link to a separate file lacks a condition, so I found no gap.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
